svg.title: Infinite limits at a vertical asymptote
svg.desc: Two graphs with a dashed vertical asymptote at x = 2. Left: y = 1/(x − 2)², which rises without bound on both sides, so the limit as x approaches 2 is +∞ from each side. Right: y = 1/(x − 2), which falls without bound from the left (−∞) and rises without bound from the right (+∞), so the one-sided infinite limits have opposite signs.
svg.text: The dashed line x = 2 is a vertical asymptote in both graphs. Check each side: the signs can match or differ.
